verdict.rationale: Context.dev documents its own browser actions: it can click, wait, or scroll before a scrape or extract captures a page, and it reports which interactions succeeded. That is a one-off pre-capture step, not continued interaction with an already-scraped page. The evidence never mentions filling forms, typing credentials, logging in, or keeping a session alive across requests. missing for 10: persistent or stateful browser sessions after a scrape, form-filling or typing actions, login-wall or authenticated-content support, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep interacting with an already-scraped page, clicking and filling forms to reach content behind a login wall

citations.quote: Click, wait, or scroll before scraping or extracting a page, then check which interactions succeeded.
